messages.subject: Problem loading camtrapR
parts:
Hi all,

I just installed camtrapR 2.0.3, but when I tried to load the package, I received this message and I don't knos what it means.

> library(camtrapR)
This is camtrapR 2.0.3 (CURRENT)
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘camtrapR’:
 .onAttach failed in attachNamespace() for 'camtrapR', details:
  call: FUN(X[[i]], ...)
  error: cannot coerce type 'closure' to vector of type 'character'

Thank you!
